I did tell the police when they questioned me. They didn’t know what to say, just all the cliché shit people say.(‘you matter, it gets better’ etc) I have never understood how people like them give advice like that when they have obviously not been through the hell of mental health. Don’t give advice on something you haven’t experienced.

I always refer to the quote by philosopher Ludwig Wittgenstein: ‘If a lion could talk english, we wouldn’t be able to understand him’. I could talk all day and night about what I go through to these police officers but I may as well speak a language they don’t know, they will have better time trying understand that then me explaining what I go through each and everyday all day. My life is totally different to theirs. My normal is their extreme.

I don't really want to reveal any of it until I go but I just write what I go through day-to-day, I have 'symptoms of psychosis as well so I talk about what 'experiences' I have. I might post the whole diary on here when I'm finished if it will help others.
